headline: Reserve Bank of India Conducts Government Bond Auction and Repo Operations
summary: The Reserve Bank of India accepted ₹33,000 crore in government bond auctions and allotted ₹25,007 crore in a 3-day variable rate repo auction.
why: These operations are essential for managing systemic liquidity and setting short-term interest rates in the Indian financial system.

impacts.name: Indian Government Bond Yields
impacts.why: Auction results directly influence the yield curve for Indian sovereign debt.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Liquidity operations and bond auctions directly influence the cost of borrowing and short-term interest rate benchmarks.
